t: Reference Architecture Library - public implementations survey
title: Reference Architecture Library - public implementations survey
definition: Stores proven starting architectures for common system types.
description:
Reference Architecture Library is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Stores proven starting architectures for common system types. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Reference Architecture Library. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Reference Architecture Library. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Reference Architecture Library capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.

t: Reference Architecture Library definition of done - practitioner discipline
title: Reference Architecture Library definition of done - practitioner discipline
definition: The definition of done discipline for Reference Architecture Library: stores proven starting architectures for common system types..
description:
definition of done is the Reference Architecture Library discipline: Stores proven starting architectures for common system types. It turns Reference Architecture Library from an event into a repeatable capability.

In practice this means: declare inputs, expected outputs, and acceptance checks before starting; run the smallest meaningful case first and verify it by hand; log every decision with its reason, so the next builder inherits understanding Teams that follow the discipline get predictable builds; teams that skip it get interesting stories. The Signature line prefers predictable builds, and this record's demo makes the discipline concrete and runnable.

t: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Reference Archite
title: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Reference Archite
definition: Ladder drill (foundation): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Reference Architecture Library from a one-paragraph brief.
description:
Drill (FOUNDATION): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Reference Architecture Library from a one-paragraph brief

Read the brief twice. List every input the Reference Architecture Library needs, every output it must produce, and one contract each input-output pair must satisfy. Work it by hand first, then run the demo program and compare its trace against your own reasoning. When they agree, the concept is yours.

Success criterion: you can list them from memory without looking at the brief
